+package config
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingConfiguration(t *testing.T) {
+	defaults, err := Load("")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, float64(1), defaults.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, defaults.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name        string
+		config      string
+		ratio       float64
+		propagators []TracingPropagator
+		err         string
+	}{
+		{name: "override", config: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, none]\n", ratio: 0.5, propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorNone}},
+		{name: "zero", config: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0\n", ratio: 0, propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}},
+		{name: "negative", config: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: -0.1\n", err: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{name: "above one", config: "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 1.1\n", err: "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{name: "invalid propagator", config: "tracing:\n  propagators: [tracecontext, unknown]\n", err: "invalid propagator option: unknown"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tc.config), 0600))
+			result, err := Load(path)
+			if tc.err != "" {
+				require.EqualError(t, err, tc.err)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, tc.ratio, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+			require.Equal(t, tc.propagators, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+		})
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/propagators/aws/xray"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/propagators/b3"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/propagators/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/propagators/ot"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
+)
+
+// NewPropagator combines the configured context propagation formats.
+func NewPropagator(formats []config.TracingPropagator) propagation.TextMapPropagator {
+	propagators := make([]propagation.TextMapPropagator, 0, len(formats))
+	for _, format := range formats {
+		switch format {
+		case config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.TraceContext{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorBaggage:
+			propagators = append(propagators, propagation.Baggage{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New())
+		case config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi:
+			propagators = append(propagators, b3.New(b3.WithInjectEncoding(b3.B3MultipleHeader)))
+		case config.TracingPropagatorJaeger:
+			propagators = append(propagators, jaeger.Jaeger{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorXRay:
+			propagators = append(propagators, xray.Propagator{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorOTTrace:
+			propagators = append(propagators, ot.OT{})
+		case config.TracingPropagatorNone:
+			// An empty composite propagator leaves carriers unchanged.
+		}
+	}
+	return propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(propagators...)
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
+)
+
+func TestNewPropagator(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		format config.TracingPropagator
+		field  string
+	}{
+		{name: "tracecontext", format: config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext, field: "traceparent"},
+		{name: "baggage", format: config.TracingPropagatorBaggage, field: "baggage"},
+		{name: "b3multi", format: config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi, field: "x-b3-traceid"},
+		{name: "jaeger", format: config.TracingPropagatorJaeger, field: "uber-trace-id"},
+		{name: "xray", format: config.TracingPropagatorXRay, field: "X-Amzn-Trace-Id"},
+		{name: "ottrace", format: config.TracingPropagatorOTTrace, field: "ot-tracer-traceid"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Contains(t, NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{tc.format}).Fields(), tc.field)
+		})
+	}
+	require.Empty(t, NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorNone}).Fields())
+
+	spanContext := trace.NewSpanContext(trace.SpanContextConfig{
+		TraceID:    trace.TraceID{1},
+		SpanID:     trace.SpanID{2},
+		TraceFlags: trace.FlagsSampled,
+	})
+	ctx := trace.ContextWithSpanContext(context.Background(), spanContext)
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		format config.TracingPropagator
+		header string
+	}{
+		{config.TracingPropagatorB3, "b3"},
+		{config.TracingPropagatorB3Multi, "x-b3-traceid"},
+	} {
+		carrier := propagation.MapCarrier{}
+		NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{tc.format}).Inject(ctx, carrier)
+		require.NotEmpty(t, carrier.Get(tc.header))
+	}
+}
